summary: Cambodia’s pledges combine restoration, conservation and agriculture. By 2035, restoration includes 600,000 ha of forest plantations, 220,000 ha of restored land and 450,000 ha of assisted natural regeneration or forest restoration—amounting to about 6.9%, 2.5% and 5.2% when compared with its current 87,100 km² forest area. Conservation targets include halving the deforestation rate by 2030, improved management of 60% of forest land by 2035, 2,000,000 ha of community forestry by 2029, and sourcing 30% of key-industry wood from certified sustainable sources by 2030 and 80% by 2035. Mixed pledges include over 96,000 ha of aquatic restoration and 6,120 ha of mangrove restoration by 2035. Agriculture covers 2,000,000 ha of rice, 756,985 ha under nutrient management, 100,000 ha under mDSR, 50,000 ha of sustainable rubber and 160,000 ha of agroforestry by 2050; the rice goal equals 25.4% of current agricultural area.
